♓ The Pisces Cloth. OFFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Piranha Rose]

Cloth Passive — Royal Demon Rose

You are immune to poison. Any creature that touches you, or that hits you with a melee attack, takes 1d6 poison damage.

Ascendant Boon — The Royal Demon Rose Garden [OFFENSE]

You radiate a 10-foot emanation of roses. At the end of each of your turns, up to four enemies in the emanation must each attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC; on a failure a creature takes 4d6 poison damage and is enfeebled 1 (cumulative to enfeebled 4).

The garden requires that you acted hostilely during that turn, and it persists even while you are unconscious.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Pisces)]

Zenith Boon — The Royal Demon Rose Garden (Zenith) [OFFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, but the emanation is 15 feet and deals 8d6 poison damage each turn. You also gain @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Bloody Rose], usable once per minute.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Pisces)]

11th-Level Cloth Ability — Crimson Thorn Garden

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crimson Thorn Garden]
